summary:
Frontend-only verification of alignment fixes and the public-vs-merchant auth-boundary fix on /pay. Ran a 10-suite Playwright suite (42 assertions). 41/42 passed on the first run; the 1 'FAIL' was a bad selector in my probe (couldn't locate the card

title), and a follow-up DOM dump proved the layout is correct — so 42/42 effectively pass. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth-boundary isolation is now correct: buyer JWT lives under localStorage.checkout_session_token, axios only sends it on /pay* and /payment* — verified via a captured POST /api/pay/getCurrencyRates whose Authorization Bearer header is a checkoutToken JWT (payload contains ref=rNtQRX, pathType=createLink), not the merchant JWT.

Fresh /pay visit before any click still writes only checkout_session_token (localStorage keys after load: [checkout_pref_currency, lang, checkout_session_token, checkout_pref_network, dp_first_touch, dynopay_cart_v1]) — merchant 'token' key is absent, so anonymous visitors won't be bounced from /devhub or /.
Merchant regression: owner token (len=2915) is byte-for-byte equal before and after visiting /pay?d=rNtQRX in the same tab; navigating back to /dashboard still renders the dashboard.

Sticky-stack ordering on mobile is correct — checkout-sticky-bar bottom=768 vs language-onboarding-bar top=787 (19px clearance); creator-sticky-cta bottom=768 vs lang bar top=787; support-chat-button (FAB) bottom=668 sits above creator-sticky-cta top=695. Dismissing the language bar drops the sticky CTA to viewport bottom (bottom==ih==844).

Layout regressions all fixed: /wallet header row wraps with Add-wallet on its own full-width row (width=358 of 390) and no bounding-box intersections between security/manage/add; /developer-keys title 'Test-API-Schlüssel' at y=706-724 sits ABOVE the sandbox-badge at y=732-752 (8px vertical gap, no overlap); /storefront 'View my page' button below the subtitle, all 3 stat tiles inside viewport (right<=358), tips link fully visible; /pay-links table width==container clientWidth==1490 (no horizontal blowout), Payments & Actions headers fully visible at 1920, at least one description cell truncates with ellipsis; row click still opens the detail drawer.

Blog: /blog/how-to-accept-crypto-payments-on-your-website and /blog/userless-payment-api-simplest-crypto-integration have documentElement.scrollWidth==390 at 390x844; blog-code-block elements individually scroll (overflow-x:auto, scrollWidth up to 635 vs clientWidth 356) instead of expanding the page.

Regression smoke: /dashboard, /transactions, /customers, /settings render at both 1920x900 and 390x844 with no horizontal overflow, zero page errors, and zero real console errors (only pre-existing dev-mode warnings which are filtered out).
seed_data_creation: none — read-only. POST /api/pay/addPayment was mocked via Playwright ctx.route to avoid reserving a real pool address.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Reusable suite at /app/scripts/qa/iter155_alignment_suite.mjs (node scripts/qa/iter155_alignment_suite.mjs). It launches multiple browser contexts (fresh mobile ctx for public/lang-bar tests, authenticated desktop/mobile ctx for merchant screens). The one thing to remember: to detect elements inside cards, the German UI labels apply ('Test-API-Schlüssel', 'Wallet hinzufügen', 'Zahlungen erhalten', 'Aktionen'). The Test API card does NOT contain an 'Active' MuiChip on this brand — only the sandbox-badge and sandbox-limits

. If future assertions need the Active chip, gate on its existence rather than requiring it.
